title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Loop Engineering: Andrew Ng popularizes the term to describe the agentic coding loops (e.g. Claude Code, OpenClaw) where agents iterate autonomously, shifting developers from QA to product steering.

SEC Reporting Debate: A major controversy emerges over proposed SEC Rule S7-2026-15, which would permit public companies to report financials semiannually instead of quarterly, raising concerns about retail investor transparency.

UBTECH Humanoid Robots: Chinese robotics firm UBTECH launched pre-leasing/sales for over 50 bipedal humanoid robots (1.6m-1.85m tall) starting at 119.8k RMB, bringing cyberpunk aesthetics to commercial reality.

Hong Kong Icon Passes: Chua Lam (蔡澜), legendary writer, film producer, and food critic, passed away at 83. He was the last surviving member of the "Four Talents of Hong Kong," marking the end of an era.

German Football Drama: Sports analysts discuss the intense pressure in the German national team's World Cup exit penalty shootout, highlighting Jonathan Tah's brave but missed penalty after other senior players hesitated.

items.title: @AndrewYNg: Loop Engineering and Feedback Loops
items.body: Andrew Ng breaks down 'loop engineering' as the core driver for next-gen coding agents (like Claude Code and OpenClaw), explaining the three essential feedback loops: agentic coding, developer feedback, and external feedback.

items.title: @sharbel: Agent Reach CLI Tool
items.body: Introduces Agent Reach, an open-source CLI that allows AI agents to search and scrape X, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu without API fees or accounts.

items.title: @higgsfield: Gemini Omni Flash Video Generation
items.body: Announces Gemini Omni Flash live on Higgsfield, offering advanced motion design, real text consistency across frames, and integration with Claude via MCP.

items.title: @_FORAB: UBTECH Humanoid Bipedal Robots
items.body: Chinese robotics pioneer UBTECH launches a pre-sale for 50 bipedal humanoid robots with heights up to 1.85m and pricing starting at 119.8k RMB.

items.title: @ExaAILabs: Exa Connect Release
items.body: Exa AI Labs launches Exa Connect, allowing AI agents to connect directly with private data providers like ZoomInfo, Crunchbase, and Similarweb.

items.title: @keepitquarterly: SEC Semiannual Reporting Rule
items.body: Warns about SEC Rule S7-2026-15, which could allow public companies to stop filing quarterly reports and only report financials every six months, sparking debate on retail investor transparency.

items.title: @TaoRay: Deflation & Lifestyle Differences
items.body: Argues that China's deflation offers a low-cost, high-quality living advantage for locals compared to the high cost of living, energy crises, and basic amenity gaps in Europe and the US.

items.title: @WangxsNB: Indie Hacking and $10k MRR Milestone
items.body: Celebrates hitting $10,000/month MRR, sharing lessons on the psychological shift from chasing venture capital to running a sustainable, self-sufficient indie development business.

items.title: @Nicole_yang88: Reality of Small Chinese Counties
items.body: Recommends a viral, unvarnished essay on the economic reality and shifting fortunes of small Chinese counties ('真实中国：中国小县城沉浮录').

items.title: @Xudong07452910: Tang Jie's AI Era Framework
items.body: Highlights Zhipu AI founder Tang Jie's framework for the AI era, prioritizing cognition and vision over technology and management.

items.title: @AriXZone: Obituary of Chua Lam
items.body: Commemorates Chua Lam (蔡澜), legendary writer, film producer, and food critic, who passed away at 83, marking the passing of all members of the historic 'Four Talents of Hong Kong.'

items.title: @pmarca: Seth Rogen & Keanu Reeves on Public Works
items.body: Marc Andreessen shares a conversation between Seth Rogen and Keanu Reeves highlighting how ultra-wealthy people no longer build public libraries, parks, or museums because modern regulatory environments make it nearly illegal.

items.title: @33monteirao: Germany Shootout & Jonathan Tah
items.body: Relates the drama in the German national team shootout where senior players hesitated, prompting defender Jonathan Tah to take his first-ever career penalty under immense pressure (which he missed).

items.title: @5xyxh: Chinese CPC 105th Anniversary Absences
items.body: Notes the unusual absence of former Chinese political standing committee members (such as Hu Jintao and Wen Jiabao) from the CPC 105th anniversary celebration.

items.title: @RB94_FCB: World Cup Exit Airport Meme
items.body: A viral meme depicting the German and Dutch national teams crossing paths at the airport after their respective World Cup exits.
